A fresh approach is needed: I will search for the exact title anchors and extract only the first unique movie title after each anchor.

```python
import re
titles = []
for anchor in ['# Movie Recommendations', '- director']:
    matches = re.finditer(f'{anchor}(.*?)(?={anchor}|$)', movie_recommendations_note['content'], dotall=True)
    for match in matches:
        title = match.group(1).strip()
        if title and title not in titles:
            titles.append(title)
reply_text = ','.join(titles)
print(reply_text)
```
